    if = { limit = { oe_yr_crisis = yes } add = 1000 }

}

        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1355.1.1 } add = 1 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_open = yes NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 0 } has_global_variable = oe_yr_stage global_var:oe_yr_stage < 3 } value = oe_yr_rd_ok }
}

    value = 0

    else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_open = yes NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 0 } global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 0 } value = 3 }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_open = yes NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 0 } global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 1 } value = 7 }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_open = yes global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 1 global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 2 } value = 9 }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_open = yes global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 2 global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 2 } value = 7 }
}
